description: This PHP class defines a database migration script for OrangeHRM, specifically for version 4.5.0. It handles creating and updating database tables related to OAuth clients, scopes, and API usage tracking during the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Defines a database migration for the OrangeHRM system, adding OAuth and API usage tables, and setting up default OAuth client data.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration by creating new tables if they do not exist, adding columns to existing tables, and inserting default OAuth client data.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version identifier for this migration, which is '4.5'.
